Our North Sikkim Tour Package offers lush valleys, snow-capped mountains, and rich cultural hotspots. Whether you are looking for a tour package for couples or families, Etripto provides every type of package according to requirements.

itinerary.title: Arrival at NJP/IXB – Transfer to Gangtok
itinerary.description:
Check-in at your hotel in Gangtok and relax for some time to explore MG road in the evening.
In the evening, explore MG Road, do shopping for souvenirs, the bustling hub of Gangtok, and do not forget to enjoy local food.

itinerary.title: Gangtok – Lachen
itinerary.description: Enjoy travelling through North Sikkim’s picturesque valleys, charming villages, and rivers.Watch snow-capped peaks and enjoy terraced fields as well as cascading waterfalls views.

itinerary.title: Lachen – Gurudongmar Lake – Lachung
itinerary.description: Explore the serene snow-capped peaks surrounding the Gurudongmar Lake, and do not forget to take photographs of the turquoise waters. Kala Pathar, a scenic viewpoint offering breathtaking panoramic views of snow-clad Himalayan peaks and pristine valleys, making it a perfect spot for photography and peaceful moments amidst nature.

itinerary.title: Lachung – Yumthang Valley – Gangtok
itinerary.description: The Yumthang Valley, also known as the Valley of Flowers, is famous for panoramic views of the Himalayan range, lush meadows, and rhododendrons.If you are a snow lover, then visit Zero Point and experience untouched snow fields as well as spectacular landscapes.By evening, begin your return journey to Gangtok, enjoying the scenic views along the way and stopping to capture beautiful photographs.

itinerary.title: Departure – Gangtok to NJP/IXB
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, check out of your Gangtok hotel.Our team member will transfer you to the NJP railway station or the Bagdogra Airport.
